tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: An appealable order is passed by the office of the Commissioner of Customs, Mumbai demanding duty of Rs. 30,46,87,136/- with applicable interest and penalty equivalent to the duty amount and fine of Rs.19,50,00,000/- under the Customs Act, 196. As per the judgement of the honorable Supreme Court dated 28th April, 2023 on the said issue, the assessee is entitled to take Input Tax Credit for duty paid. Further, on basis of our assessment, we believe that the consequential demand for penalty and fine is not sustainable. The Company is in the process of preferring an appeal against the said demand before the appellate authority.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed appeal before the CESTAT on 14-01-2025 against the Order of Commissioner of Customs (Adjudication), Mumbai.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company had paid GST on Royalty @ 12 % at the time of filing GST3B relying on Sr.no 1 of the Notification No. 10/2017-1GST (Rate) dated 28" June 2017 till August 2022 under a bona fide impression that GST Rate applicable to the said transaction is 12%. During the annual internal review, it was observed there was a new notification No. 06/2021 - Central Tax (Rate) Dated 30-09-2021, which levied tax @ 18% on such transaction with immediate effect. Accordingly, a differential provision of 6% on Royalty was created in the books on 1st September 2022 and was paid along with applicable Interest on 15th October 2022. Despite the Suo-moto compliance, the Department passed the Order dated 13.05.2025 and has imposed a penalty for short payment of GST.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed appeal before the Additional /Joint Commissioner (Appeals) of CGST and Central Excise, Vadodara on 13-06-2025.

guidance.statement: Fluoropolymers growth expected around 15% to 20% compared to last year in FY27.
Fluoropolymer revenue to grow 17-20% annually, driven by volume and high-value products.
Battery materials revenue to reach a three-digit number by Q4FY27, with significant ramp-up in FY28.
FY27 capex plan of ₹2,300 Cr in EV and about ₹800 Cr in chemicals, part of a ₹6,000 Cr programme.
guidance.target: ₹2,300 Cr EV + ~₹800 Cr chemicals in FY27

guidance.statement: R32 capacity expansion expected commissioned in Q2FY27; R134A capacity expected during FY27.
guidance.target: R32 in Q2FY27, R134A in FY27

entities.name: GFCL EV New Age Materials SAOC

industry: Commodities > Chemicals > Chemicals & Petrochemicals > Specialty Chemicals

operating_notes.text: Company received ₹11 Cr on 24 April 2026 towards full and final claim for loss of PPE regarding the 2021 Ranjitnagar fire.
Fully redeemed listed secured NCDs aggregating to ₹16 Cr on 20 March 2026.
Planned ₹2,300 Cr capex for FY27 across battery material portfolio.
Earmarked ₹3,150 Cr capex for FY27, comprising ₹2,300 Cr for EV battery materials and ₹850 Cr for GFL.
Material subsidiary GFCL EV Products Limited incorporated a step-down subsidiary, GFCL EV New Age Materials SAOC, in Oman for battery chemicals.
R32 capacity is almost fully utilised; the expansion is expected to take total capacity to 20,000 tonnes, with full utilisation expected in calendar 2027.
About 40-50% of R32 sales are on long-term contracts, with the rest spot or contract-to-contract, and domestic and export prices are said to be very close.
Battery materials: LiPF6 qualification almost finished, PVDF close to finalisation, and LFP cathode active material revenue expected towards the end of FY27.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,369 Cr (+11.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹112 Cr (-41.4% YoY).
Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited’s Board, chaired by Bhavin Desai, recommended a final dividend of ₹3 per share for FY2025-26 on May 26, 2026, pending shareholder approval.
Gujarat Fluorochemicals reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,369 Cr and net profit of ₹112 Cr, and outlined battery materials expansion plans.
Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited shared the audio recording of its 26 May 2026 analysts/institutional investors conference call discussing 4QFY26 financials at 18:00 IST.
On June 1, 2026, Gujarat Fluorochemicals filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call held on May 26, 2026, detailing FY27 capex plans of ₹3,150 Cr and battery materials progress.
Gujarat Fluorochemicals announced the incorporation of a step-down subsidiary, GFCL EV New Age Materials SAOC, in Oman by its material subsidiary GFCL EV Products Limited.
